question: Why did the integrated route still show a net climate-change burden after product-substitution credits?
expect: premise false: after system expansion the net climate-change impact was negative, −2,257.14 kg CO2-eq per t (a net benefit) (abstract)
rendered: The integrated route still showed a net climate-change burden after product-substitution credits because the foreground climate-change impact of the leaching-residue-valorization stage (1,940.11 kg CO2-eq) was not fully offset by the avoided-production credit of the composite phase-change energy-storage material (-2,922.21 kg CO2-eq). The net result was a net climate-change impact of -982.10 kg CO2-eq.
